2751.sigma:
title: LiteLLM Virtual Key Minted With Wildcard allowed_routes (CVE-2026-47101)
id: 6b3a4f1c-d2f5-4f0e-8e91-7c4a5a2c1d11
status: experimental
description: Detects POST requests to LiteLLM key/team management endpoints whose JSON body sets allowed_routes to a wildcard "/*", the authorization-bypass payload disclosed by Obsidian Security as the first link in the LiteLLM CVE-2026-47101 chain.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/litellm-vulnerability-chain-lets-low.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1078.003
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_method:
    cs-method: POST
  selection_url:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/key/generate'
      - '/key/update'
      - '/team/new'
      - '/team/update'
      - '/team/member_add'
  selection_body:
    cs-body|contains|all:
      - 'allowed_routes'
      - '/*'
  condition: selection_method and selection_url and selection_body
falsepositives:
  - LiteLLM proxy administrators legitimately creating super-keys for trusted automation
level: high
2751.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.http_method) as method values(Web.user) as user values(Web.dest) as dest from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.http_method="POST" (Web.url="*/key/generate*" OR Web.url="*/key/update*" OR Web.url="*/team/new*" OR Web.url="*/team/update*" OR Web.url="*/team/member_add*") by Web.src Web.url Web.http_user_agent | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | join type=left src [search index=* sourcetype=*waf* OR sourcetype=*nginx* OR sourcetype=*proxy* method=POST (uri_path="*/key/generate*" OR uri_path="*/key/update*") ("allowed_routes" AND ("/*" OR "\"/*\"")) | stats values(_raw) as raw_body by src] | where isnotnull(raw_body) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2751.datadog: (source:nginx OR source:apache OR source:python OR source:cloudflare) @http.method:POST (@http.url_details.path:(*/key/generate* OR */key/update* OR */team/new* OR */team/update*)) @http.request.body:(*allowed_routes* AND *\"/*\"*)
2751.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/applicationelb (ALB access logs in front of LiteLLM) or the app's own access log group
fields @timestamp, client_ip, request, target_status_code, user_agent, request_creation_time
| filter request like /POST .*\/(key\/generate|key\/update|team\/new|team\/update|team\/member_add)/
| filter @message like /allowed_routes/
| filter @message like /"\/\*"/
| sort @timestamp desc

2753.sigma:
title: LiteLLM Proxy Process Spawning Shell or Network Tool (CVE-2026-40217 / CVE-2026-42271)
id: 4c1e8f2a-9d3b-4e7c-b6f1-2a8c9d4e5f63
status: experimental
description: Detects the LiteLLM Python proxy (uvicorn/gunicorn running litellm) spawning an OS shell, netcat, curl/wget, or another interpreter — the post-exploit footprint of the Custom Code Guardrail sandbox escape (CVE-2026-40217) and the stdio-MCP subprocess CVE (CVE-2026-42271, CISA KEV).
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/litellm-vulnerability-chain-lets-low.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/python3.10'
      - '/python3.11'
      - '/python3.12'
      - '/uvicorn'
      - '/gunicorn'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'litellm'
  selection_child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/socat'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/perl'
  selection_child_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'bash -i'
      - '/dev/tcp/'
      - 'os.system'
      - 'import pty'
      - 'socket.socket'
  condition: selection_parent and (selection_child_image or selection_child_cmd)
falsepositives:
  - LiteLLM custom guardrails legitimately shelling out to a vetted helper script (rare; should be vetted)
  - Container init scripts wrapping litellm with curl-based health checks
level: high
2753.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_name) as child values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("python","python3","python3.10","python3.11","python3.12","uvicorn","gunicorn") (Processes.parent_process="*litellm*" OR Processes.parent_process="*uvicorn*litellm*" OR Processes.parent_process="*gunicorn*litellm*") (Processes.process_name IN ("sh","bash","dash","zsh","nc","ncat","socat","curl","wget","perl","ruby") OR Processes.process="*bash -i*" OR Processes.process="*/dev/tcp/*" OR Processes.process="*os.system*" OR Processes.process="*import pty*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2753.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE (@process.parent.executable.path:(*/python* OR */uvicorn OR */gunicorn) AND @process.parent.command_line:*litellm*) AND (@process.executable.path:(*/bash OR */sh OR */dash OR */nc OR */ncat OR */socat OR */curl OR */wget OR */perl) OR @process.command_line:(*bash\ -i* OR */dev/tcp/* OR *os.system* OR *import\ pty*))
2753.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(python(3(\.\d+)?)?|uvicorn|gunicorn)$/i
| regex("litellm", field=ParentCommandLine)
| (ImageFileName=/\/(sh|bash|dash|zsh|nc|ncat|socat|curl|wget|perl|ruby)$/i OR regex("(bash -i|\/dev\/tcp\/|os\.system|import pty|socket\.socket)", field=CommandLine))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2754.sigma:
title: LiteLLM config.yaml Modified by Non-Editor Process
id: 7f2b4d8a-3c9e-4a1f-8d7b-1c5e8b4f3a92
status: experimental
description: Detects writes to LiteLLM's config.yaml (where litellm_settings.callbacks lives) by processes other than common editors. Callbacks fire on every request and never surface in the admin UI — explicit hiding spot for post-RCE attackers per the Obsidian disclosure.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/litellm-vulnerability-chain-lets-low.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1546
  - attack.t1554
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/litellm/'
      - '/etc/litellm/'
      - '/opt/litellm/'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - 'config.yaml'
      - 'litellm_config.yaml'
      - 'proxy_config.yaml'
  filter_editor:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/vim'
      - '/nano'
      - '/vi'
      - '/emacs'
      - '/code'
      - '/nvim'
  condition: selection and not filter_editor
falsepositives:
  - Configuration-management tooling (Ansible, Salt, Puppet) — should be allowlisted by its known image path
  - Helm/kustomize templating during a planned rollout
level: high
2754.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.action) as action values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action IN ("modified","created","renamed") (Filesystem.file_name IN ("config.yaml","litellm_config.yaml","proxy_config.yaml","litellm.config.yaml") OR Filesystem.file_path="*/litellm/*config*.yaml" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/etc/litellm/*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where NOT match(writer,"(?i)^(vim|nano|vi|emacs|code|nvim)$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2754.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:PATH (@file.path:(*/litellm/*config*.yaml* OR */etc/litellm/* OR */opt/litellm/*config*.yaml*)) -@process.executable.path:(*/vim OR */nano OR */vi OR */emacs OR */code OR */nvim)
2754.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\/(litellm|etc\/litellm|opt\/litellm)\/.*config.*\.yaml$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\/(vim|nano|vi|emacs|code|nvim)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, UserName], function=count())

| where (FolderPath has_any ("/etc/hosts") or FileName in~ ("_fanout.sh"))

     | where scStatus == 200

     | where ScStatus == 200
     | project AdminTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = CIp, AdminUri = CsUriStem,
               UA = UserAgent, Host = CsHost);

  union isfuzzy=true
    (W3CIISLog
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours + 1h)

     | project LoginTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = CIp);

         and datetime_diff('second', AdminTime, LoginTime) between (0 .. LoginWindowSec)

id: 7a4e1d2c-8b3f-4e9a-9c1d-3f2b7c4d8e5a
description: Detects inbound HTTP requests carrying the phar:/// three-or-more-slash wrapper variant that bypasses PHPSpreadsheet File::prohibitWrappers (CVE-2026-45034 patch bypass for CVE-2026-34084).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-87m4-826x-3crx
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_literal:
    cs-uri-query|re|i: 'phar:/{3,}'
  selection_encoded:
    cs-uri-query|re|i: 'phar%3a%2f%2f%2f'
  selection_stem:
    cs-uri-stem|re|i: '(phar:/{3,}|phar%3a%2f%2f%2f)'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Authorised pentest / vuln-scanner traffic (Nessus, Acunetix, Burp)
  - Internal security regression tests for the CVE-2026-45034 patch
level: high
2923.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.url) as urls values(Web.http_user_agent) as user_agents values(Web.http_method) as methods from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*phar://*" OR Web.url="*phar%3A%2F%2F*" OR Web.url="*phar%3a%2f%2f*") by Web.dest Web.src Web.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| eval bypass_attempt=if(match(urls,"(?i)phar:/{3,}") OR match(urls,"(?i)phar%3a%2f%2f%2f"),"yes","no")
| eval cve="CVE-2026-45034"
| where bypass_attempt="yes"
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2923.datadog: (source:nginx OR source:apache OR source:aws.alb OR source:cloudfront OR source:apache_error) ("phar:///" OR "phar%3A%2F%2F%2F" OR "phar%3a%2f%2f%2f")

2924.sigma:
title: PHP / Web-Server Worker Spawning Shell or Network LOLBin (CVE-2026-45034 post-exploit)
id: 1c8e6a4d-2f5b-4a3e-9d7c-6b8a1f3e2c4d
description: Detects post-RCE behaviour where php-fpm, apache, nginx or w3wp spawn shell/network tools — the gadget chain in the CVE-2026-45034 patch bypass executes inside the web worker on PHP 7.x.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-87m4-826x-3crx
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent_webworker:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/php-fpm'
      - '/php'
      - '/php-cgi'
      - '/apache2'
      - '/httpd'
      - '/nginx'
      - '\php-fpm.exe'
      - '\php.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
      - '\w3wp.exe'
  child_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/socat'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/perl'
      - '/ruby'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
  condition: parent_webworker and child_lolbin
falsepositives:
  - Image processing pipelines (ImageMagick, ffmpeg) invoked via shell from PHP
  - Deployment / config-management agents shelling out from web context
  - Legitimate webhook handlers that exec system commands
level: medium
2924.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_path) as paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("php-fpm","php-fpm.exe","php","php.exe","php-cgi.exe","apache2","httpd","httpd.exe","nginx","nginx.exe","w3wp.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("sh","bash","dash","zsh","ksh","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","python","python3","python.exe","perl","ruby","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval cve="CVE-2026-45034"
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2924.datadog: (source:linux.auditd OR source:windows.sysmon) AND @process.parent.name:(*php-fpm* OR *php.exe OR php OR *apache2* OR *httpd* OR *nginx* OR *w3wp.exe*) AND @process.name:(sh OR bash OR dash OR zsh OR cmd.exe OR powershell.exe OR pwsh.exe OR curl OR curl.exe OR wget OR wget.exe OR nc OR ncat OR socat OR python OR python3 OR perl OR certutil.exe OR bitsadmin.exe)

2925.sigma:
title: Phar Archive or pwned_marker File Written by PHP / Web-Server Worker (CVE-2026-45034)
id: 9b3d8c1e-4f6a-4c7b-8e2d-5a9c1f7b3d6e
description: Detects .phar archives or the published PoC 'pwned_marker' file being written by a php-fpm, apache, nginx, or w3wp worker — both are staging or successful-exploit artefacts for CVE-2026-45034.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-87m4-826x-3crx
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  parent_webworker:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/php-fpm'
      - '/php'
      - '/php-cgi'
      - '/apache2'
      - '/httpd'
      - '/nginx'
      - '\php-fpm.exe'
      - '\php.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
      - '\w3wp.exe'
  phar_artefact:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.phar'
  poc_marker:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '/pwned_marker'
      - '\pwned_marker'
      - '/exploit.phar'
      - '\exploit.phar'
  condition: parent_webworker and (phar_artefact or poc_marker)
falsepositives:
  - Deliberate phar-based application deployment / composer package extraction
  - Internal red-team replaying the published PoC against a lab host
level: high
2925.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths values(Filesystem.process_name) as procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.phar" OR Filesystem.file_name="pwned_marker" OR Filesystem.file_name="exploit.phar") AND Filesystem.process_name IN ("php-fpm","php-fpm.exe","php","php.exe","apache2","httpd","httpd.exe","nginx","nginx.exe","w3wp.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| eval cve="CVE-2026-45034"
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2925.datadog: (source:linux.auditd OR source:windows.sysmon) AND @process.name:(*php-fpm* OR php OR *php.exe OR *apache2* OR *httpd* OR *nginx* OR *w3wp.exe*) AND (@file.name:*.phar OR @file.name:pwned_marker OR @file.name:exploit.phar OR @file.path:*pwned_marker* OR @file.path:*\.phar)

2926.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — AI brands as bait: How threat actors are using the AI hype in social engineering
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("profluxeflowai-win-setup.exe", "pythonw.exe", "deepseek-v4-flash_x64.exe", "tradeai.exe", "deepseek-v4-pro_x64.exe", "manus_ai_desktop_x64.exe", "seedance_x64.exe", "gpt-5.5-pro_x64.exe", "gpt-5.5-thinking_x64.exe", "kimi-swarm-station_x64.exe", "fraudgpt_x64.exe", "grokcli_x64.exe", "gemma-4-omni_x64.exe", "ltx-2.3_x64.exe", "win-setup.exe") or FolderPath has_any ("\AppData\Local\"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")

| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

title: ChatGPT Plus Payment-Update Phishing Lure
id: 0b1f5e8a-4c5d-4a3b-9b2e-5c1f7a4d8e21
description: Detects MSTI-reported ChatGPT-impersonating phishing wave using the 'update your payment method' urgency lure (May 2026).
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/06/08/ai-brands-as-bait-how-threat-actors-are-using-the-ai-hype-in-social-engineering/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1566.002
  - attack.t1656

  product: m365
  service: threat_management
  category: email

    Subject|contains: 'ChatGPT Plus'

2932.sigma:
title: Vulnerable cordova-plugin-inappbrowser install (CVE-2026-47430)
id: 8e6c4b8a-3d2a-4e6f-9d7b-1c0e2a4b8d6a
description: |
  Detects npm / yarn / pnpm / cordova / ionic CLI invocations that install
  cordova-plugin-inappbrowser in a version range vulnerable to CVE-2026-47430
  (3.1.0 through 6.0.0). Pinned safe versions (>=6.0.1) are excluded.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q42j-x8rq-pjg6
author: Detection engineering
date: 2026/06/14
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.001
  - cve.2026.47430
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\npm.cmd'
      - '\npx.exe'
      - '\yarn.exe'
      - '\pnpm.exe'
      - '\cordova.cmd'
      - '\cordova.exe'
      - '\ionic.cmd'
      - '\node.exe'
  selection_pkg:
    CommandLine|contains: 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser'
  selection_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' install'
      - ' add'
      - ' plugin add'
  filter_safe_pin:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@6.0.1'
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@6.0.2'
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@6.1'
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@7'
  filter_uninstall:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' uninstall'
      - ' remove '
      - ' rm '
      - ' list '
      - ' ls '
  condition: selection_proc and selection_pkg and selection_action and not (filter_safe_pin or filter_uninstall)
level: medium
falsepositives:
  - Developer intentionally pinning to a still-vulnerable version for compatibility testing
  - Security researcher reproducing the CVE in a sandbox repo
  - CI agent restoring a legacy package-lock.json that still references 5.x
2932.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("npm.exe","npm.cmd","npx.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","cordova.cmd","cordova.exe","ionic.cmd","node.exe")) Processes.process="*cordova-plugin-inappbrowser*" (Processes.process="* install*" OR Processes.process="* add*" OR Processes.process="*plugin add*" OR Processes.process="* i *" OR Processes.process="*--save*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rex field=process "cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@(?<pinned_version>\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"
| where isnull(pinned_version) OR match(pinned_version,"^(3\.|4\.|5\.|6\.0\.0$)")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)

id: 7d8e9a1f-3c4b-4e5d-9a6b-2c1d3e4f5a6b
status: experimental
description: Detects Stata executables spawning command shells, indicating likely exploitation of CVE-2026-47708 in stata-mcp where the log_file_name parameter is interpolated unsanitised into a Stata command, permitting Stata `shell` command injection.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4p62-hqp5-g644
  - https://github.com/SepineTam/stata-mcp/commit/e6f945941ae0c7cf5e74a428e0b3dc82b396382f
author: detection-pipeline
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\stata.exe'
      - '\stata-mp.exe'
      - '\stata-se.exe'
      - '\stata-be.exe'
      - '\xstata.exe'
      - '\xstata-mp.exe'
      - '\xstata-se.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Researcher-authored do-files that intentionally call Stata's `shell` command
  - Legitimate stata-mcp `python` integration that spawns python.exe
level: high
2949.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("stata.exe","stata-mp.exe","stata-se.exe","stata-be.exe","xstata.exe","xstata-mp.exe","xstata-se.exe","stata","stata-mp","stata-se","stata-be")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","zsh","bash","sh","python.exe","python","python3")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2949.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon OR source:windows.security) @ParentImage:(*\\stata.exe OR *\\STATA.exe OR *\\Stata.exe OR *\\stata-mp.exe OR *\\StataMP.exe OR *\\stata-se.exe OR *\\stata-be.exe OR *\\xstata.exe OR *\\xstata-mp.exe OR *\\xstata-se.exe) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\bash.exe OR *\\sh.exe OR *\\python.exe OR *\\Python.exe)
2949.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(stata|stata-mp|stata-se|stata-be|xstata|xstata-mp|xstata-se)(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|bash|sh|zsh|python3?)\.exe$/i or ImageFileName=/\/(bash|sh|zsh|python3?)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2950.def:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("stata.exe","stata-mp.exe","stata-se.exe","stata-be.exe","xstata.exe","xstata-mp.exe","xstata-se.exe","python.exe","python","python3")

2950.sent:

| where TargetFileName endswith ".log"

2950.sigma:
title: Stata-Written Log File With Shell Metacharacters or Path Traversal (CVE-2026-47708)
id: 9b1c2d3e-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects .log files written by Stata or the stata-mcp Python wrapper whose filename contains shell metacharacters (semicolon, pipe, backtick, quote) or path traversal sequences, the deterministic artefact of CVE-2026-47708 exploitation against unpatched stata-mcp installations (<1.17.3).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4p62-hqp5-g644
  - https://github.com/SepineTam/stata-mcp/commit/e6f945941ae0c7cf5e74a428e0b3dc82b396382f
author: detection-pipeline
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\stata.exe'
      - '\stata-mp.exe'
      - '\stata-se.exe'
      - '\stata-be.exe'
      - '\xstata.exe'
      - '\xstata-mp.exe'
      - '\xstata-se.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.log'
  selection_payload:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - ';'
      - '|'
      - '`'
      - "'"
      - '"'
      - '..'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_ext and selection_payload
falsepositives:
  - Researchers using single-quote characters in legitimate Stata log filenames (rare)
level: high
2950.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.process_name IN ("stata.exe","stata-mp.exe","stata-se.exe","stata-be.exe","xstata.exe","xstata-mp.exe","xstata-se.exe","stata","stata-mp","stata-se","stata-be","python.exe","python","python3")) AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.log") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where match(file_name,"[;|&`'\"]|\\.\\.") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2950.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @Image:(*\\stata.exe OR *\\STATA.exe OR *\\stata-mp.exe OR *\\stata-se.exe OR *\\stata-be.exe OR *\\xstata.exe OR *\\python.exe) @TargetFilename:(*.log) @TargetFilename:(*\;* OR *\|* OR *\&* OR *..* OR *\`* OR *\'* OR *\"*)
2950.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| ContextImageFileName=/(stata|stata-mp|stata-se|stata-be|xstata|xstata-mp|xstata-se|python3?)(\.exe)?$/i
| TargetFileName=/\.log$/i
| regex("[;|&`'\"]|\\.\\.", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

let exfilHost = "t.m-kosche.com";
let exfilPath = "/api/public/otel/v1/traces";
union isfuzzy=true
(DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where RemoteUrl has exfilHost or RemoteUrl has exfilPath

            InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
            InitiatingProcessFolderPath, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort,

(DeviceEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where ActionType in ("DnsQueryResponse","ConnectionSuccess","NetworkConnectionEvents")
  | where RemoteUrl has exfilHost or AdditionalFields has exfilHost
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
            InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
            InitiatingProcessFolderPath, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort,
            Source="DeviceEvents")
| order by Timestamp desc

let exfilHost = "t.m-kosche.com";
let exfilPath = "/api/public/otel/v1/traces";

  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where Url has exfilHost or Url has exfilPath
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, ClientIP=SrcIpAddr, Name=DstHostname, QueryType=Url, Source="ImWebSession")

2952.def:
// TeamPCP Mini Shai-Hulud: Bun spawned from npm preinstall
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "bun.exe" or FileName =~ "bun"
| where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("npm.exe","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe","npm-cli.js","node","npm","yarn","pnpm","npx"))
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("preinstall","setup.mjs","execution.js")
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup.mjs","execution.js")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
2952.sent:
// TeamPCP Mini Shai-Hulud: Bun spawned from npm preinstall (Sentinel — SecurityEvent 4688 + ASIM)
union isfuzzy=true
(SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where EventID == 4688
  | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bun.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "/bun"
  | where (ParentProcessName has_any ("\\npm.exe","\\node.exe","\\yarn.exe","\\pnpm.exe","\\npx.exe","/npm","/node","/yarn","/pnpm","/npx"))
       or CommandLine has_any ("setup.mjs","execution.js","preinstall")
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account=SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Source="SecurityEvent"),
(ImProcessCreate
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where TargetProcessName endswith "bun.exe" or TargetProcessName endswith "/bun"
  | where (ParentProcessName has_any ("npm.exe","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe"))
       or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup.mjs","execution.js")
       or ParentProcessCommandLine has "preinstall"
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, Account=ActorUsername, NewProcessName=TargetProcessName, CommandLine=TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, Source="ImProcessCreate")
| order by TimeGenerated desc

),

title: Jupyter Enterprise Gateway Python Spawns Shell or Reads K8s SA Token (CVE-2026-44181)
id: 71a3b8f2-7d18-4a8b-a6c3-3b1f9b4b2a5c
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious child processes (shells, recon binaries) or Kubernetes service-account token reads from the python process running Jupyter Enterprise Gateway, indicative of SSTI RCE post-exploitation (CVE-2026-44181, GHSA-f49j-v924-fx9w).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f49j-v924-fx9w
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1552.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  parent_python:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/python3.10'
      - '/python3.11'
      - '/python3.12'
  suspicious_child_shell:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/ash'
      - '/hostname'
      - '/id'
      - '/whoami'
      - '/uname'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/kubectl'
  token_read:
    CommandLine|contains: '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount'
  condition: parent_python and (suspicious_child_shell or token_read)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Jupyter kernel-launcher subprocess.Popen invocations to start a Python kernel (those launch python child, not sh/bash/curl)
  - Container init/healthcheck reading hostname (uncommon with python parent)
level: high

2991.def:
let bunUrlIndicators = dynamic(["github.com/oven-sh/bun", "oven-sh/bun/releases", "bun-windows-x64", "bun-linux-x64", "bun-darwin"]);
let npmParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe"]);
let downloaderChildren = dynamic(["node.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe","wget.exe","bun.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","pwsh.exe"]);
// Process-tree pivot — npm parent spawning a downloader child with Bun URL on the command line
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (npmParents) or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (npmParents)
    | where FileName in~ (downloaderChildren)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
// Network pivot — same process families connecting to github.com for the Bun release tarball

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType in ("FileOpened","FileAccessed","FileCreated")
| where FolderPath startswith "/proc/" and FileName == "mem"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node","bun")
| extend TargetPid = extract(@"/proc/(\d+)/", 1, FolderPath)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName has_any ("Runner.Worker","Runner.Listener")
    | project DeviceId, TargetPid = tostring(ProcessId), RunnerCmd = ProcessCommandLine, RunnerName = FileName
) on DeviceId, TargetPid
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, TargetPid, RunnerName, RunnerCmd
| order by Timestamp desc
2997.sent:
let ProcMemRe = @"/proc/\d+/mem";
let RunnerHits = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where SyslogMessage matches regex ProcMemRe
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("node", "bun")
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, HostName, Facility, ProcessName, SyslogMessage;
let AsimHits = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where TargetFilePath matches regex ProcMemRe
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("node", "bun")
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetFilePath;
union isfuzzy=true RunnerHits, AsimHits
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2997.sigma:
title: Node or Bun reads /proc/<pid>/mem (Runner.Worker secret scrape)
id: 7c1b9d2e-3a4c-4f60-9e1b-4a7c8f604f8a
description: Detects the redhat-cloud-services implant reading /proc/<pid>/mem from a node or bun process to scrape in-memory secrets held by GitHub Actions Runner.Worker.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/multiple-redhat-cloud-services-npm-packages-compromised
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/01
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.007
  - attack.t1552.001
logsource:
  category: file_access
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/node'
      - '/bun'
    TargetFilename|re: '^/proc/[0-9]+/mem$'
  condition: selection
level: critical
2997.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.process_name) as proc values(Filesystem.process_path) as proc_path values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action="read" Filesystem.file_path="/proc/*/mem" Filesystem.process_name IN ("node","bun") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rex field=file_path "/proc/(?<target_pid>\d+)/mem" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
2997.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:(SYSCALL OR PATH) @file.path:/proc/*/mem @process.name:(node OR bun OR Node OR Bun) -@process.executable.path:(/usr/bin/gdb OR /usr/bin/strace OR /usr/lib/systemd/*)
2997.falcon:
#event_simpleName=/^(FileOpenInfo|FileWritten)$/
| TargetFileName=/^\/proc\/[0-9]+\/mem$/
| ContextImageFileName=/\/(node|bun)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2998.def:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where (FolderPath startswith "/tmp/" and FileName in~ ("bun","bun.exe")) or (InitiatingProcessFolderPath startswith "/tmp/" and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("bun","bun.exe"))
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node","node.exe","npm","bun")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"/tmp/p[A-Za-z0-9]+\.js"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2998.sent:
let TmpJsRe = @"/tmp/p[A-Za-z0-9]+\.js";
let AsimHits = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where (ActingProcessName endswith "/bun" or ActingProcessName endswith "/node" or ActingProcessName endswith "/npm")
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex TmpJsRe or ActingProcessCommandLine matches regex TmpJsRe
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine;
let SyslogHits = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where SyslogMessage matches regex TmpJsRe
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("bun", "node")
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, HostName, ProcessName, SyslogMessage;
union isfuzzy=true AsimHits, SyslogHits
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2998.sigma:
title: Bun in /tmp executes randomly-named /tmp/p<random>.js implant
id: 9e1b4a7c-8f60-1b9d-2e3c-4a517c1b9d2e
description: Detects the redhat-cloud-services Stage 4 implant pattern — Bun binary located in /tmp executing /tmp/p<random>.js, invoked from a node/npm parent.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/multiple-redhat-cloud-services-npm-packages-compromised
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/01
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1140
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_bun_in_tmp:
    Image|re: '^/tmp/[^/]+/bun$'
  selection_runs_p_js:
    CommandLine|re: '/tmp/p[A-Za-z0-9]+\.js'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/node'
      - '/npm'
  condition: (selection_bun_in_tmp or selection_parent) and selection_runs_p_js
level: critical
2998.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_path="/tmp/*/bun" OR Processes.process_path="/tmp/*/bun.exe" OR Processes.process_name="bun") Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node","npm","node.exe") Processes.process="*/tmp/p*.js*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_id Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
2998.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE ((@process.executable.path:/tmp/*/bun AND @process.command_line:*/tmp/p*.js*) OR (@process.parent.name:(node OR npm OR bun) AND @process.command_line:(*/tmp/bun*/tmp/p*.js* OR *bun */tmp/p*.js*)))
2998.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/^\/tmp\/[^\/]+\/bun$/i OR ParentBaseFileName=/^bun$/i)
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(node|npm|bun)$/i
| regex("\\/tmp\\/p[A-Za-z0-9]+\\.js", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
